verdicts.core_release_candidate: all frozen automated and independent core evidence passes; no claim about Javen adoption or behavior improvement
verdicts.human_onboarding_verified: core candidate plus a real Javen-authenticated onboarding and non-fixture paper journey; still no longitudinal claim
verdicts.longitudinal_personal_validation: a Javen-preregistered field-use window closes and its burden, abandonment, recovery and discipline criteria pass
verdicts.design_reopened: field-use fails or reveals a new high-impact workflow hazard

required_inputs: one real current market snapshot with non-fixture pedigree
one real research case containing at least one support, one challenge and one unknown
one human decision including no-trade as an available outcome

initial_policy_cooling.rule: first mandate and policy are scheduled, not immediately active; changes during cooling restart the interval

urgency_state_machine.rule: human selects urgency in the authenticated UI; AI/import cannot set it. urgent/panic creates a server-time cooldown and invalidates any earlier approval. The delay has no runtime override.
urgency_state_machine.anti_rubber_stamp: emotion text alone never satisfies the gate; human must answer a randomly selected counterfactual prompt after authentication, and the server records prompt id, elapsed interval and answer hash. This adds friction but does not prove reflection; that residual limit remains visible.

minimum_structure: all attempts and abandoned starts count
long-gap resume is exercised at least once if such a gap naturally occurs
longitudinal_protocol.failure_rule: failed burden, abandonment, recovery or discipline criterion yields design_reopened; it cannot be converted to pass by changing the window after results are visible
